findings.title: Review delay may need a closer look
findings.detail: The invented cohort has longer review intervals. Check reviewer availability and batch size before choosing an explanation.
limitations: Synthetic observations. No real repository inference.
Twenty eligible observations are censored and ten are missing.

findings.title: No estimate for unobserved work
findings.detail: This projection does not infer the effort or value of work outside its observed window.
limitations: Observed counts are not developer productivity.
